title: Heated Iran Debate: Mehdi vs. Ex-Trump Deputy Press Secretary
author: Team Zeteo
content:
As the Iran war heats up and the genocide in Gaza continues, **Mehdi** went on
'Piers Morgan Uncensored' to respond to French public intellectual Bernard-
Henri Levy's blind defense of [Israel](https://zeteo.com/p/author-of-ihra-
antisemitism-definition?r=3uiw9m), and also to debate former White House
deputy press secretary Hogan Gidley on Iran.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**" Bill Clinton, George W. Bush, Barack Obama, [Joe
Biden](https://zeteo.com/p/palestinian-suffering-was-never-
guiding?r=3uiw9m&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web), every single president
[Netanyahu](https://zeteo.com/p/this-week-in-palestine-israel-
kills-5a6?r=3uiw9m) asked to bomb Iran, none of them were dumb enough to do
it. Only your former boss was dumb enough to do it."** Mehdi told Gidley in a
heated conversation that covered Russia's war on Ukraine, Trump's war on Iran,
and the U.S. president's legal issues concerning sexual abuse compared to
those of [Russell Brand's](https://zeteo.com/p/maga-influencer-russell-brand-
convicted?r=3uiw9m).

Watch the full video above to also hear what Mehdi thought of the famous BHL
(Bernard-Henri Levy) telling Piers that in all the wars he has seen, he has
never seen an army **" caring as much"** as the Israeli army. Yes, he actually
said that.
